mapper.select: /* selectMasterMdCmCatalogUnitPriceHistoryPop */ SELECT CQEP.BUYER_ITEM_NO, CQEP.CONTRACT_NO, CQEP.CONTRACT_SEQ, CQEP.PRICE_SEQ, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CQEP.ADD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(CQEP.ADD_TIME, 'HH24MISS'),'HH24:MI') AS ADD_TIME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = CQEP.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_ID, CQEP.UNIT_PRICE, CQEP.LIST_PRICE, DECODE(CQEP.UNIT_PRICE_CHANGE_REASON, '', '', (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M074' AND CODE = CQEP.UNIT_PRICE_CHANGE_REASON)) AS UNIT_PRICE_CHANGE_REASON_TEXT, DECODE(CQEP.LIST_PRICE_CHANGE_REASON, '', '', (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M074' AND CODE = CQEP.LIST_PRICE_CHANGE_REASON)) AS LIST_PRICE_CHANGE_REASON_TEXT FROM ICOMCQEP CQEP WHERE 1=1 AND CQEP.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND CQEP.CONTRACT_NO = #{st_contract_no} AND CQEP.CONTRACT_SEQ = #{st_contract_seq} AND CQEP.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_buyer_item_no} ORDER BY CQEP.ADD_DATE DESC, CQEP.ADD_TIME DESC
